ThingDef.label: void harness implant
ThingDef.description: This implant combines subcutaneous flakweave implants (for protection against vacuum and stellar radiation) with miniature integrated mind-impulse thrusters to allow agile movement in the void. Techpriests or skitarii specialised for void breacher duties are often outfitted with this set of augmetics, although air supply has to be provided elsewhere.
